source.content: public class SoqlFixtureProvider implements SoqlStubProvider { public List<SObject> handleSoqlQuery(Schema.SObjectType targetType, String query, Map<String,Object> binds) { Map<String,Object> row = new Map<String,Object>{'Id' => '001000000000123', 'Name' => query}; return Test.createStubQueryRows(targetType, new List<Map<String,Object>>{row}); } public Object clone() { return this; } }
public virtual class Greeter { public virtual String say(String name) { return 'real'; } }

public class GreeterProvider implements StubProvider { public Object handleMethodCall(Object stubbedObject, String stubbedMethodName, Type returnType, List<Type> listOfParamTypes, List<String> listOfParamNames, List<Object> listOfArgs) { return 'hello ' + String.valueOf(listOfArgs[0]); } public Object clone() { return this; } }

@isTest private class TestUICallbackContractsTest { @isTest static void contracts() { Test.setCurrentPage(new PageReference('/apex/one')); System.assertEquals('/apex/one', ApexPages.currentPage().getUrl()); Test.setCurrentPageReference(new PageReference('/apex/two')); System.assertEquals('/apex/two', ApexPages.currentPage().getUrl()); ApexPages.addMessage(new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, 'Summary', 'Detail')); Object messageList = new List<ApexPages.Message>{new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.WARNING, 'List', 'Detail')}; ApexPages.addMessages(messageList); try { Integer quotient = 1 / 0; System.assertEquals(0, quotient); } catch (Exception e) { ApexPages.addMessages(e); } System.assert(ApexPages.hasMessages()); System.assert(ApexPages.hasMessages(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR)); System.assert(ApexPages.hasMessages(ApexPages.Severity.WARNING)); System.assert(!ApexPages.hasMessages(ApexPages.Severity.INFO)); System.assertEquals(3, ApexPages.getMessages().size()); Test.createSoqlStub(Account.SObjectType, new SoqlFixtureProvider()); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assert(rows[0].Name.contains('Account')); SObject one = Test.createStubQueryRow(Account.SObjectType, new Map<String,Object>{'Name' => 'One'}); System.assertEquals('One', ((Account)one).Name); List<SObject> many = Test.createStubQueryRows(Account.SObjectType, new List<Map<String,Object>>{new Map<String,Object>{'Name' => 'Many'}}); System.assertEquals('Many', ((Account)many[0]).Name); Greeter greeter = (Greeter)Test.createStub(Greeter.class, new GreeterProvider()); System.assertEquals('hello Ada', greeter.say('Ada')); HttpResponse callback = Test.getExternalService().sendCallback(new HttpRequest()); System.assertEquals(200, callback.getStatusCode()); } }
